title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to quickly copy a report layout (Create a copy of the selected layout)
summary: Report layouts control report content and formatting in Business Central. Users can quickly copy an existing layout by selecting it, toggling 'Save Changes to Copy', entering a new name, and confirming on the Report Layouts page.
key_points: Report layouts determine which fields, arrangement, and styling appear in reports
Four layout types are available: Word, RDLC, Excel, and External
The 'Save Changes to Copy' toggle enables quick duplication without exporting and importing
Copied layouts can be customized after creation

quotes.text: A report layout controls the content and format of a report.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines what report layouts fundamentally do and their importance in Business Central

quotes.text: Copying an existing layout lets you quickly create a new, identical layout that you can customize.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the primary benefit and workflow for the copy feature
